    From the reversed ray paths to paths of Q_P #

    the reversed ray quiver on RayVertex C is reversed: an arrow i ⟶ j is an irreducible morphism j.obj ⟶ i.obj, and rayPathMap (p.comp q) = rayPathMap q ≫ rayPathMap p. A reversed ray path p : i ⟶ j therefore becomes a path toP p of the quiver of P = RaySmall C from ⟨j.obj⟩ to ⟨i.obj⟩ with value sh (rayPathMap p); the reverse translation fromP sends interlacing steps of nonzero paths to proper-whisker steps, so non-interlaced reversed contours give non-interlaced contours of P.

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.rayPathMap_comp' {C : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, 0} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms C] {i j l : RayVertex C} (p : Quiver.Path i j) (q : Quiver.Path j l) :
    rayPathMap (p.comp q) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (rayPathMap q) (rayPathMap p)
